title: Global cis-regulatory landscape of double-stranded DNA viruses.
authors: Taslim, Tommy Henry; Finkelberg, Joseph Alexander; Kales, Susan; Soto-Ugaldi, Luis; D'Elia, Benedetta; Engin, Berkay; Munoz-Esquivel, George; Morara, Elvis; Purinton, Jacob; Chandok, Harshpreet; Rottenberg, Jaice Theodore; Castro, Rodrigo; Martinez-Cuesta, Lucia; Paz, Matias Alejandro; Tewhey, Ryan; Bass, Juan Ignacio Fuxman
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文通过大规模报告分析和机器学习模型鉴定双链DNA病毒中的顺式调控元件及其转录因子调控因子，虽非直接建模TF-DNA三维互作，但聚焦病毒CRE与TF结合调控，方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合位点预测研究。
abstract: Most double-stranded DNA (dsDNA) viruses use the host transcriptional machinery to express viral genes for replication and immune evasion. This is mediated by viral cis-regulatory elements (CREs) regulated by host and viral transcription factors (TFs). Although some viral CREs and their regulatory mechanisms have been determined, most remain unidentified. Here, we used massively parallel reporter assays to identify ~2,000 CREs across 27 dsDNA viruses from the Adenovirus, Herpesvirus, Polyomavirus and Papillomavirus families. Viral genomes have a higher CRE density than the human genome, with most viral CREs having promoter-like features and overlapping protein coding sequences. Using saturation mutagenesis and machine learning models, we report viral CRE regulators, including SP, ETS, bZIPs, and TFs acting downstream of signal-activated pathways. Altogether, we present a comprehensive functional CRE map of human-infecting dsDNA viruses that serves as a blueprint for further studies in viral regulation, reactivation, evolution, and viral vector design.
abstract_zh: 大多数双链DNA（dsDNA）病毒利用宿主转录机制表达病毒基因，以进行复制和免疫逃逸。这一过程由病毒顺式调控元件（cis-regulatory elements, CREs）介导，这些元件受宿主和病毒转录因子（transcription factors, TFs）调控。尽管一些病毒CRE及其调控机制已被确定，但大多数仍未被识别。在此，我们使用大规模平行报告基因分析，在来自腺病毒科（Adenovirus）、疱疹病毒科（Herpesvirus）、多瘤病毒科（Polyomavirus）和乳头瘤病毒科（Papillomavirus）的27种dsDNA病毒中鉴定出约2,000个CRE。病毒基因组中的CRE密度高于人类基因组，且大多数病毒CRE具有启动子样特征并重叠蛋白质编码序列。通过饱和突变和机器学习模型，我们报告了病毒CRE调控因子，包括SP、ETS、bZIPs以及信号激活通路下游作用的TFs。总体而言，我们呈现了一个人类感染性dsDNA病毒的全面功能性CRE图谱，为病毒调控、再激活、进化及病毒载体设计的进一步研究提供了蓝图。
